reading.title: A Day in Abuelo's Kitchen
reading.purpose: Follow Ana through a kitchen day full of science.
paras: Ana fills a tray with water. The cold freezer makes it freeze into a solid. Later, an ice cube starts to melt in her cup and turns back into a liquid.
Abuelo will boil water for tea. He stirs sugar into the cup, and it begins to dissolve. A grape will sink, but a cork will float.

qs.q: An ice cube starts to melt. What does melt mean?
choices: To change from solid to liquid with heat.
qs.why: Melt means a solid changes into a liquid when it gets warm.
The reading says a grape will sink, but a cork will float.
The reading says Abuelo will boil water for tea.

reading.retellFrame: The water was a ___ and then it became a ___.

needsReview.reason: Facts to confirm for a classroom demo: a grape sinks, a cork floats. Adult boils the water on purpose (safety).
